environment.fixtures: Original synthetic canvas/video/audio and pinned official French OCR model

evidence.name: declined microphone and late permission grants leave no capture resources
silence uploads nothing and stop flushes speech once then closes every resource
browser-ended live tracks release audio nodes and repeated starts leave no listeners
full live queue stops capture, drains at most four items and requires pending work to finish
capture setup failure and streams without shared audio release all granted tracks
screen permission decline, late grant, ended sharing and missing video clean up
preview coordinates follow letterboxing, object positions, cover cropping and resize
caption overlap preserves multiline RTL, reselecting native captions hides duplicates
CJK OCR removes segmentation separators without changing Latin, Korean or line breaks
inpainting includes antialiasing strokes just outside tight OCR bounds
OCR and PDF callers can choose different mask fringes without altering outer pixels
every PCM segment is independently decodable WAV with sample-based times
VAD skips idle silence, retains preroll and closes speech at a pause
PCM fractional resampling keeps accurate durations over many blocks
local inpainting removes glyph pixels and preserves colored background/outside pixels
RTL text and grapheme wrapping preserve combining marks/newlines
124 pinned OCR models reject invalid IDs and corrupt data before worker loading
Tesseract object-language initialization uses code and build rejects upstream drift
bridge speech auto derives authenticated route and hosted override stays separate
native caption reader restores disabled tracks and sidecar cue timing
segment flush clears state before a queue-overload callback can stop capture
live cancellation drops pending results and overload does not flush into a full queue
screen OCR normalized presets and reversed drag stay inside the captured video
caption reader hides duplicate native captions, switches selected tracks and restores mode
live AudioWorklet automatically emits complete low-latency WAV chunks
downloaded French OCR initializes safely and repeats from offline model cache
dynamic open-shadow captions translate and supplied sidecar timing survives
screen subtitle fallback captures visible text locally and releases sharing tracks
screen OCR preset and preview drag select the intended region and persist
CJK and mixed-language OCR translate colored images and preserve detailed backgrounds on export
live permission decline, silent AudioWorklet input and browser-ended sharing recover cleanly
native overlapping multiline RTL captions toggle, reselect tracks and follow fullscreen
screen OCR retries failed translation, maps letterboxed preview drag and stops on capture end

limitations: Capture permission grants/declines and browser-ended events are controlled test doubles; the suite does not automate an operating-system permission picker or physical devices.
Chinese, Japanese, mixed English/Chinese and French OCR fixtures exercise selected real models; they do not measure all 124 models or accuracy on arbitrary images.
Export assertions preserve colored backgrounds and detailed pixels outside text regions. Local harmonic inpainting does not guarantee texture, art or typography reconstruction.
Native captions use standard text tracks and a controlled local VP8 video; commercial player APIs, encrypted streams and protected-video capture are outside this evidence.
Speech transport uses real AudioWorklet PCM capture with a deterministic transcription endpoint; recognition quality and hosted/AGY model quality are separate acceptance areas.
Fullscreen checks exercise a player container. Native browser-only fullscreen video controls and closed player internals are not established.
